name: Encyclo-K
intro: Encyclo-K以知识语句而非问题作为策展单位：从权威教材截图提取独立正确语句，用DeepSeek-R1生成欺骗性错误对应语句，再以程序化随机抽样动态组装多语句选择题。标准配置包含5,038道中英文题，并用多层正则和选项正文回退解析答案。
org: Institute of Automation of the Chinese Academy Sciences, University of Manchester, Peking University
build_method: 62本教材截图与马赛克, doubao-1.5-vision-pro-32k提取正确语句, 三人复核, DeepSeek-R1六类错误改写, 程序化动态组题
eval_feature: 语句级策展, 8–10语句/4–8选项动态组题, 中英双语, 多层答案解析, 未解析计错
build_method_en: 62 textbook screenshots and mosaic masking, doubao-1.5-vision-pro-32k correct-statement extraction, three-person review, six-pattern DeepSeek-R1 false rewrites, programmatic dynamic assembly
eval_feature_en: Statement-level curation, dynamic 8–10-statement/4–8-option questions, bilingual coverage, tiered answer parsing, misses counted wrong
intro_en: Encyclo-K curates knowledge statements rather than fixed questions: it extracts standalone correct statements from authoritative textbook screenshots, uses DeepSeek-R1 to create deceptive false counterparts, and programmatically samples them into dynamic multi-statement MCQs. Its standard configuration has 5,038 English and Chinese questions and parses answers through regex tiers plus option-content fallback.

drawio_review_note: Evidence is frozen to arXiv:2512.24867v2 (PDF SHA-256 8a026701696635772be885054ad66d343e1f07639d24a994c6554b5d522b3494), official repo commit 5549c738bc3f6b2d24948be33e29fef2cc23cd13, and Hugging Face m-a-p/Encyclo-K revision 0f81da9652b9c4d7bad73ce9576d81901d9441f2 (encyclo-k_all_prompt.jsonl LFS SHA-256 2165d589a73555fa4a20a07b1d4ad94c15ee5de36f551d470e0832a31316b066). The diagram preserves the paper's scoped hierarchy counts: 62 textbooks / 43 source subfields / 11 disciplines in Section 3.1.1 versus 44 fields / 62 final subfields in Table 1. It records screenshot capture and mosaic masking; doubao-1.5-vision-pro-32k extraction; the exact 3,269 + 642 + 127 sequential removals; three-annotator review of all 21,525 correct statements; DeepSeek-R1's six error patterns; short filtering to 21,494 false statements; the 200-item false-statement audit with five rationale mismatches but no additional processing; 43,019 total statements and language counts; 8–10 statements, 4–8 options, and 2–4 statements per option; 5,038 questions split 3,286 English / 1,752 Chinese; and last-line-first regex, full-response regex, exact option-content fallback, and miss-as-wrong accuracy. The pinned repo releases the dataset and evaluator but no statement extractor, false-statement generator, question-builder code, or standard generation seed; those implementation details remain undisclosed.
